scope: Full-size CAD placement rationale; pin assignments describe implemented tabletop bench firmware, not an approved full-size harness.

BP01_base_plate.title: Base plate
BP01_base_plate.role: Transfers post reactions into an engineered foundation.
BP01_base_plate.placement: At each post foot to spread connection forces and provide an anchor pattern.
BP01_base_plate.limitation: Anchor design, edge distances, grout, soil and uplift capacity are not approved.
BP01_base_plate.validation: Inspect the first article and verify the relevant interface before release.

P01_front_post.title: Front structural post
P01_front_post.role: Supports the roof and connects it to the foundation.
P01_front_post.placement: At the front corners to keep the central entrance open.
P01_front_post.limitation: Wind, lateral stability, welds and corrosion protection require structural design.
P01_front_post.validation: Inspect the first article and verify the relevant interface before release.

P02_rear_post.title: Rear structural post
P02_rear_post.role: Supports the higher edge of the roof.
P02_rear_post.placement: 120 mm taller than the front posts to establish the proposed roof slope.
P02_rear_post.limitation: Member sizing and the complete load path are unverified.
P02_rear_post.validation: Inspect the first article and verify the relevant interface before release.

B01_crossbeam.title: Roof crossbeam
B01_crossbeam.role: Spans between posts and supports roof purlins.
B01_crossbeam.placement: Above the occupied zone to keep the floor clear.
B01_crossbeam.limitation: The simple beam screening is not a code-compliant structural calculation.
B01_crossbeam.validation: Inspect the first article and verify the relevant interface before release.

R01_roof_purlin.title: Sloping roof purlin
R01_roof_purlin.role: Carries roof panels to the crossbeams.
R01_roof_purlin.placement: Follows the roof slope and divides the panel span.
R01_roof_purlin.limitation: Rear seating relief and local strength need an engineer’s approval.
R01_roof_purlin.validation: Inspect the first article and verify the relevant interface before release.

CP01_roof_connection.title: Roof connection plate
CP01_roof_connection.role: Provides a proposed bolted interface between roof members.
CP01_roof_connection.placement: At purlin/crossbeam interfaces where loads change direction.
CP01_roof_connection.limitation: Bolts, bearing, welds, prying and uplift must be designed.
CP01_roof_connection.validation: Inspect the first article and verify the relevant interface before release.

SP01_roof_spacer.title: Roof air-gap spacer
SP01_roof_spacer.placement: Between roof layers so a ventilated gap can remain open.
SP01_roof_spacer.limitation: An air gap alone does not prove cooling; test temperatures and wind-driven rain.
SP01_roof_spacer.validation: Inspect the first article and verify the relevant interface before release.

CP02_spacer_cap.title: Spacer cap plate
CP02_spacer_cap.role: Provides a fastening surface above each spacer.
CP02_spacer_cap.placement: At the upper roof fixing axes to distribute local loads.
CP02_spacer_cap.limitation: Fixing seals, panel bearing and uplift resistance are unresolved.
CP02_spacer_cap.validation: Inspect the first article and verify the relevant interface before release.

RF01_lower_skin.title: Lower shade roof
RF01_lower_skin.role: Shades the occupied zone beneath the upper skin.
RF01_lower_skin.placement: Below the upper roof to separate the occupant from the sun-facing surface.
RF01_lower_skin.limitation: Panel joints, sag, condensate and fixing details need fabrication review.
RF01_lower_skin.validation: Inspect the first article and verify the relevant interface before release.

RF02_upper_skin.title: Reflective upper roof
RF02_upper_skin.role: Intercepts sunlight and provides the outer weather surface.
RF02_upper_skin.placement: Above the ventilated gap; overhangs reduce direct sun exposure.
RF02_upper_skin.limitation: Reflectance, coating life, roof runoff and actual thermal performance need testing.
RF02_upper_skin.validation: Inspect the first article and verify the relevant interface before release.

G01_knee_gusset.title: Corner knee gusset
G01_knee_gusset.placement: At front corners to resist local joint rotation.
G01_knee_gusset.limitation: Two gussets do not establish whole-frame lateral stability.
G01_knee_gusset.validation: Inspect the first article and verify the relevant interface before release.

ST01_bench_leg.title: Bench leg
ST01_bench_leg.role: Carries the bench frame to the supporting surface.
ST01_bench_leg.placement: Under the seat perimeter to keep the seating surface supported.
ST01_bench_leg.limitation: Proof load, tipping, foot attachment and corrosion tests are outstanding.
ST01_bench_leg.validation: Inspect the first article and verify the relevant interface before release.

ST02_bench_rail.title: Longitudinal bench rail
ST02_bench_rail.role: Connects bench legs and supports transverse rails.
ST02_bench_rail.placement: Runs along the seat length as part of its load path.
ST02_bench_rail.limitation: Connection design and occupied load capacity remain unverified.
ST02_bench_rail.validation: Inspect the first article and verify the relevant interface before release.

ST04_bench_crossrail.title: Transverse seat support
ST04_bench_crossrail.role: Supports all six seat slats across their width.
ST04_bench_crossrail.placement: Three rails cross beneath the slats so no slat relies only on its ends.
ST04_bench_crossrail.limitation: Fasteners, timber movement and bench load tests are required.
ST04_bench_crossrail.validation: Inspect the first article and verify the relevant interface before release.

ST03_seat_slat.title: Replaceable seat slat
ST03_seat_slat.placement: At a proposed 450 mm seat height with gaps between slats.
ST03_seat_slat.limitation: Comfort, splinters, edge radii, accessibility and timber durability need user/physical checks.
ST03_seat_slat.validation: Inspect the first article and verify the relevant interface before release.

JA01_louvre.title: Shade louvre
JA01_louvre.role: Reduces oblique sunlight while leaving openings for air.
JA01_louvre.placement: Along the rear screen; an opening is retained around the fan.
JA01_louvre.limitation: Orientation and spacing trade shade for airflow resistance; measure both.
JA01_louvre.validation: Inspect the first article and verify the relevant interface before release.

JA02_screen_rail.title: Screen support rail
JA02_screen_rail.placement: Across the rear screen to allow individual slat replacement.
JA02_screen_rail.limitation: Attachment strength, wind loading and tool access are not verified.
JA02_screen_rail.validation: Inspect the first article and verify the relevant interface before release.

E01_dry_enclosure.title: Dry electronics enclosure
E01_dry_enclosure.role: Houses the controller and low-voltage electronics.
E01_dry_enclosure.placement: On the right rear side, away from the separate water vessel and floor splash.
E01_dry_enclosure.limitation: This is an enclosure candidate, not an IP-rated product. Seal, antenna, heat and service access checks remain.
E01_dry_enclosure.validation: Inspect the first article and verify the relevant interface before release.

E02_service_lid.title: Removable service lid
E02_service_lid.role: Allows access for wiring, inspection and replacement.
E02_service_lid.placement: Above the electronics carrier; the teaching cutaway hides it to reveal internals.
E02_service_lid.limitation: The removable lid does not yet include a validated gasket, latch or hinge design.
E02_service_lid.validation: Inspect the first article and verify the relevant interface before release.

E03_component_carrier.title: Insulated electronics carrier
E03_component_carrier.role: Organizes replaceable electronic modules inside the enclosure.
E03_component_carrier.placement: Raised from the enclosure floor to support insulated mounting and wiring clearance.
E03_component_carrier.limitation: Metal carrier requires insulating standoffs; exact mounting holes and clearances need purchased parts.
E03_component_carrier.validation: Inspect the first article and verify the relevant interface before release.

F01_fan_cartridge.title: Removable fan mount
F01_fan_cartridge.role: Holds the fan and enables replacement.
F01_fan_cartridge.placement: Behind the seating area, aimed toward the occupied zone.
F01_fan_cartridge.limitation: Useful seated airflow must be measured; direction, guard losses, noise and vibration need testing.
F01_fan_cartridge.validation: Inspect the first article and verify the relevant interface before release.

F02_fan_guard.title: Fan guard
F02_fan_guard.role: Reduces access to the blade area.
F02_fan_guard.placement: One guard on each side of the fan.
F02_fan_guard.limitation: These shapes are not certified finger guards; opening size, strength and blade clearance need checks.
F02_fan_guard.validation: Inspect the first article and verify the relevant interface before release.

F03_reference_fan.title: Fan + tachometer
F03_reference_fan.role: Moves air; tach feedback reports rotation.
F03_reference_fan.placement: At the rear above seat level to direct airflow toward occupants.
F03_reference_fan.limitation: Full-size NF-A20 is only a dimensional reference: IP50, and 0% PWM is not an off command. Select an outdoor-rated actuator and hardware isolation.
F03_reference_fan.connection: Bench reference: separate 12 V fan supply; GPIO25 → NPN open-collector PWM stage; tach → GPIO34 with external 10 kΩ pull-up to 3.3 V. Full-size wiring/rating must be redesigned.
F03_reference_fan.validation: Compare tach pulses with an independent tachometer, then map actual seated air speed using an external anemometer. Test stop/isolation separately.

S01_sensor_shield.title: Temperature/humidity shield
S01_sensor_shield.role: Reduces direct radiative exposure around an air sensor.
S01_sensor_shield.placement: Surrounds each SHT31, separate from heat-producing controller electronics.
S01_sensor_shield.limitation: Current shield is a simplified hollow envelope. Ventilation, radiation bias and rain resistance are unverified.
S01_sensor_shield.validation: Inspect the first article and verify the relevant interface before release.

E04_ESP32_reference.title: ESP32 controller
E04_ESP32_reference.role: Reads sensors, validates readings, runs local controls and emits telemetry.
E04_ESP32_reference.placement: Inside the dry enclosure, on an insulated removable carrier close to local controls.
E04_ESP32_reference.limitation: Metal enclosure can attenuate Wi-Fi; current firmware uses USB serial, not Wi-Fi. Board outline is a reference, not a checked supplier fit.
E04_ESP32_reference.connection: Bench: USB power + serial at 115200 baud; GPIO21/22 I²C; GPIO25 PWM; GPIO34 tach; GPIO35 float; GPIO32/33/27 buttons; GPIO26 LED; GPIO14 buzzer; GPIO4 roof probe.
E04_ESP32_reference.validation: Bench-test disconnected sensors, manual control, reboot recovery and watchdog behavior. Confirm firmware pin map and purchased board dimensions.

E05_monitor_reference.title: INA219 power monitor
E05_monitor_reference.role: Measures voltage/current-derived power in the fan branch.
E05_monitor_reference.placement: Inside the dry enclosure near the fan supply wiring.
E05_monitor_reference.limitation: This excludes controller and display consumption. Verify the selected shunt and branch rating; do not claim total-system energy.
E05_monitor_reference.connection: I²C 0x40 on GPIO21 SDA / GPIO22 SCL, 3.3 V logic. Fan supply positive → fuse → switch → VIN+ → VIN− → fan. Common signal ground.
E05_monitor_reference.validation: Compare with a calibrated external meter at several fan duties; document that only the fan branch is measured.

E06_display_reference.title: OLED local display
E06_display_reference.role: Shows readings, fan state and assistance/fault messages.
E06_display_reference.placement: On the enclosure front so status can be read without opening it or using internet.
E06_display_reference.limitation: Sunlight readability, sealing and seated reach/visibility are not validated.
E06_display_reference.connection: I²C 0x3C on GPIO21/22; use verified 3.3 V-compatible logic/pull-ups.
E06_display_reference.validation: Confirm every displayed status against firmware and test sunlight readability, fault text and seated viewing angle.

S02_roof_probe.title: DS18B20 roof probe
S02_roof_probe.role: Measures a roof surface temperature when thermally coupled.
S02_roof_probe.placement: Near the centre of the lower roof, away from an edge-biased sample.
S02_roof_probe.limitation: The present vertical probe envelope ends near, but not bonded to, the lower skin. A contact shoe/adhesive, strain relief and calibration are still required.
S02_roof_probe.connection: Powered 3-wire 1-Wire sensor: GPIO4 data with 4.7 kΩ pull-up to 3.3 V, plus 3.3 V and GND.
S02_roof_probe.validation: Bond the probe using a defined contact method, compare with a calibrated surface reference and report contact/radiation uncertainty.

W01_optional_water_vessel.title: Optional experiment vessel
W01_optional_water_vessel.placement: On the opposite side from the dry electronics.
W01_optional_water_vessel.limitation: No pump, misting or evaporative control is implemented. Hygiene, drainage and water benefit are open experiments.
W01_optional_water_vessel.validation: Inspect the first article and verify the relevant interface before release.

HW01_M10_bolt_reference.title: M10 fastener reference
HW01_M10_bolt_reference.role: Shows a proposed mechanical fastening axis.
HW01_M10_bolt_reference.placement: At the connection holes to communicate assembly intent.
HW01_M10_bolt_reference.limitation: Unthreaded envelope only: nut, washer, grade, grip length and torque selection remain open.
HW01_M10_bolt_reference.validation: Inspect the first article and verify the relevant interface before release.

HW02_M16_anchor_reference.title: Foundation anchor reference
HW02_M16_anchor_reference.role: Shows the proposed anchor position below a base plate.
HW02_M16_anchor_reference.placement: At each base-plate hole to communicate the foundation interface.
HW02_M16_anchor_reference.limitation: Not a foundation design: embedment, concrete, soil, edge distance and uplift are unspecified.
HW02_M16_anchor_reference.validation: Inspect the first article and verify the relevant interface before release.

C01_cable_trunk.title: Protected cable route
C01_cable_trunk.placement: Along the rear right structure to keep cables away from the walking area.
C01_cable_trunk.limitation: Only a route envelope is modeled. Harnesses, glands, drip loops, bend radii and segregation need detailing.
C01_cable_trunk.validation: Inspect the first article and verify the relevant interface before release.

MT01_rear_service_rail.title: Rear service rail
MT01_rear_service_rail.role: Provides a support line for the fan assembly.
MT01_rear_service_rail.placement: Across the rear frame behind the occupied space.
MT01_rear_service_rail.limitation: Connection and vibration strength need inspection and test.
MT01_rear_service_rail.validation: Inspect the first article and verify the relevant interface before release.

MT02_fan_support_arm.title: Fan support arm
MT02_fan_support_arm.role: Connects the fan mount to the rear support.
MT02_fan_support_arm.placement: A pair of arms helps support the cartridge independently of the shade louvres.
MT02_fan_support_arm.limitation: Check stiffness, screw access and fatigue from fan vibration.
MT02_fan_support_arm.validation: Inspect the first article and verify the relevant interface before release.

MT03_enclosure_backrail.title: Enclosure back rail
MT03_enclosure_backrail.role: Supports the dry enclosure independently of its circuit board.
MT03_enclosure_backrail.placement: Behind the enclosure, outside the service volume.
MT03_enclosure_backrail.limitation: Attachment details and weather protection require supplier review.
MT03_enclosure_backrail.validation: Inspect the first article and verify the relevant interface before release.

MT04_enclosure_return.title: Enclosure support return
MT04_enclosure_return.role: Completes the proposed enclosure support path.
MT04_enclosure_return.limitation: Weld/bolt details, local loading and service clearance need approval.
MT04_enclosure_return.validation: Inspect the first article and verify the relevant interface before release.

MT05_seated_sensor_stem.title: Seated sensor support
MT05_seated_sensor_stem.role: Holds the sensor around the proposed breathing-zone height.
MT05_seated_sensor_stem.placement: Rises from the bench area to place the shield about 1.1 m above the base.
MT05_seated_sensor_stem.limitation: One point does not represent all occupants; map airflow and radiation at multiple positions.
MT05_seated_sensor_stem.validation: Inspect the first article and verify the relevant interface before release.

MT06_reference_sensor_stem.title: Reference sensor support
MT06_reference_sensor_stem.role: Positions the comparison sensor separately from the bench sensor.
MT06_reference_sensor_stem.placement: On an independent support near the shelter edge.
MT06_reference_sensor_stem.limitation: Current position can still lie under the roof overhang. It is not automatically a valid unshaded control.
MT06_reference_sensor_stem.validation: Inspect the first article and verify the relevant interface before release.

MT07_sensor_foot.title: Reference sensor foot
MT07_sensor_foot.placement: At ground level beneath the independent sensor mast.
MT07_sensor_foot.limitation: Anti-tip stability, trip hazards and anchoring need site review.
MT07_sensor_foot.validation: Inspect the first article and verify the relevant interface before release.

E07_button_reference.title: Local push button
E07_button_reference.role: Provides a physical local control input.
E07_button_reference.placement: On the front face for access without opening the enclosure.
E07_button_reference.limitation: Button size, labels, ingress protection and reach need a human-factors check.
E07_button_reference.connection: Active-low switch to GND with internal pull-up; the selected instance determines the GPIO and action.
E07_button_reference.validation: Inspect the first article and verify the relevant interface before release.

E08_LED_reference.title: Status / assistance LED
E08_LED_reference.role: Shows a latched assistance request or selected fault states.
E08_LED_reference.placement: On the front panel next to the controls.
E08_LED_reference.limitation: A single indicator cannot identify every condition; read the OLED. Brightness and visibility need testing.
E08_LED_reference.connection: GPIO26 → 330 Ω resistor → LED → GND; assistance, fan fault or sensor fault lights the indicator.
E08_LED_reference.validation: Trigger help, sensor fault and fan feedback fault separately; confirm LED visibility without confusing the conditions.

E09_buzzer_reference.title: Assistance buzzer
E09_buzzer_reference.role: Sounds a periodic local alert while assistance is latched.
E09_buzzer_reference.placement: Inside the enclosure near the user controls.
E09_buzzer_reference.limitation: Enclosure attenuation and sound level are untested. It does not contact emergency services.
E09_buzzer_reference.connection: GPIO14 → NPN driver stage, not motor/buzzer power directly from GPIO. Flyback protection if the selected buzzer is inductive.
E09_buzzer_reference.validation: Press help, verify periodic sound, reboot persistence and acknowledgement; measure audibility without assuming emergency coverage.

S03_SHT31_reference.title: SHT31 air sensor
S03_SHT31_reference.role: Measures local dry-bulb air temperature and relative humidity.
S03_SHT31_reference.placement: Inside a dedicated shield, away from the controller heat source.
S03_SHT31_reference.limitation: Neither T/RH alone nor this geometry establishes thermal safety; calibrate and assess radiation/airflow bias.
S03_SHT31_reference.connection: Bench I²C GPIO21/22: comparison sensor 0x44, seated sensor 0x45 (ADR high); 3.3 V logic. Full-size cable lengths require a qualified interface.
S03_SHT31_reference.validation: Inspect the first article and verify the relevant interface before release.

W02_float_reference.title: Water availability switch
W02_float_reference.placement: Inside the optional water vessel, separate from dry electronics.
W02_float_reference.limitation: Nominal envelope only. Verify switch level, orientation, material compatibility and broken-wire behavior.
W02_float_reference.connection: GPIO35 with external 10 kΩ pull-up to 3.3 V; closed contact to GND = available, open/broken wire = low/check.
W02_float_reference.validation: Test wet/dry states, a disconnected wire and the chosen switching height before adding water near electronics.

outdoor_SHT31.title: Reference SHT31 · I²C 0x44
outdoor_SHT31.placement: At the separate reference mast near the left edge, physically separated from the occupied sensor. This is a proposed comparison position, not a validated ambient reference.
outdoor_SHT31.validation: Move/position a paired control outside shelter influence, match shields/heights, swap positions across repeated runs and record calibration.

seated_SHT31.title: Seated SHT31 · I²C 0x45
seated_SHT31.placement: Inside the bench-zone shield around 1.13 m above the base. Separated from ESP32 heat; not placed inside the electronics box.
seated_SHT31.validation: Calibrate against the reference, inspect shield bias and sample multiple occupied-zone positions without using a person as a test load.

mode_button.title: Mode button · GPIO32
mode_button.role: Toggles the bench between off and manual 70% fan duty.
mode_button.connection: GPIO32, active-low to GND with internal pull-up; debounced in firmware.
mode_button.validation: Verify toggle, restart behavior and fan feedback. Full-size fan requires a true hardware off path.

assistance_button.title: Assistance button · GPIO33
assistance_button.role: Latches a local help request; the request is restored after a reboot.
assistance_button.connection: GPIO33, active-low to GND; NVS stores the latch. LED, buzzer and OLED provide local indication.
assistance_button.validation: Press, reboot and confirm the request persists. It is not an automatic emergency call.

acknowledge_button.title: Acknowledge button · GPIO27
acknowledge_button.role: Deliberately clears the local assistance latch.
acknowledge_button.connection: GPIO27, active-low to GND. A simultaneous help press takes priority.
acknowledge_button.validation: Confirm only deliberate acknowledgement clears the request.

reference_sensor.title: Reference sensor shield
reference_sensor.placement: On the independent left mast around 1.1 m height; the SHT31 board is inside.
reference_sensor.limitation: Current near-edge position may remain under the overhang. Shield geometry is provisional and does not establish an unbiased reference.

seated_sensor.title: Seated-zone sensor shield
seated_sensor.placement: On the bench stem around 1.1 m height, separate from controller heat.
seated_sensor.limitation: Radiation shielding, air exchange, rain exclusion and fan-jet bias need physical validation.
